limitations: Synthetic TTS, authored screen PNGs and actual Vision/ASR/LLM. No user microphone, native window capture, editor insertion or Windows evidence.
Original approved memory constructed after initial ASR observations: exposed development reproduction, not held-out quality or preexisting user memory.
Screen-off native01 and cache variants reuse original speech and are not independent samples.

Technical regression reveals added negation; preserve failure rather than declaring entire pipeline correct.
